metadata.title: Open my salon — {platform}
metadata.description: Set up your online booking page in minutes: {promise}, no commitment.

intro.headline: Take your salon online
intro.lead: A few minutes is all it takes: your booking page, your schedule and your checkout, in one place.

highlights.booking: Your clients book online, around the clock
highlights.reminders: Confirmations and reminders sent for you

form.title: Create my salon
form.name: Salon name
form.slugHint: Your clients will book at /your-address. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
form.languageHint: The language your booking page opens in. You can change it later in your settings.
form.confirmationMismatch: the two passwords do not match
form.consent: I agree that my data and my salon’s data may be processed to create and run my workspace.
form.consentRequired: Tick this box to create your salon.
form.fineprint: {promise}. Your card is stored by Stripe and is only charged at the end of the trial. Cancel any time.

fieldErrors.name: Enter your salon’s name.
fieldErrors.slug: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only — 63 characters at most.
fieldErrors.slugReserved: This name is reserved by the platform — please choose another one.
fieldErrors.postalCode: This postal code is too long.
fieldErrors.defaultCurrency: Choose the currency of your prices.
fieldErrors.defaultLocale: Choose the language your salon opens in.
fieldErrors.password: Your password must be at least twelve characters.

errors.title: Sign-up did not go through
errors.slugTaken: This address is already taken — please choose another one.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email address. Sign in, or use another address.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is momentarily unavailable. Please try again in a few seconds.
